experiment_data.hypothesis: L1 instruction-dominant heads (24/32 with >50% text attention) are causally necessary for instruction routing: ablating their instruction attention should collapse downstream instruction classification accuracy from ~100% to near-chance, while ablating non-dominant heads (control) should have minimal effect. This upgrades C2 (front-loaded routing) from correlational to partially causal.
experiment_data.notes: D057. 3 conditions: (A) ablate all 24 dominant heads, (B) ablate 8 non-dominant heads (control), (C) no ablation (baseline, existing data). Also graduated: top-5 strongest heads. Monkey-patch layers[1].self_attn.forward, zero instruction token positions after softmax + renormalize. Extract features at L1/L8/L16/L31, run cross-instruction 10-way classifier + action probe R². GPU: westd-19183 cuda:0, ~1.5-2 GPU·h.
